name: evidence-cabinet
description: A College-owned evidence cabinet for extenuating-circumstances claims. Connects to My College; EBVS holds no key that can read it.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long random string you make up (at least 20 characters). You type it once on the cabinet's **/setup** page to create the first administrator. Delete this secret afterwards.

DB.description: The cabinet's database. **Choose EU jurisdiction** if you are asked, and check it after deploying (Storage & Databases → D1).

EVIDENCE.description: The evidence bucket, EU jurisdiction. Check after deploying (R2 → bucket → Settings).
